name: CMMI (Capability Maturity Model Integration)
description: A process improvement framework assessing organizational maturity across five levels (Initial to Optimizing) in development, services, or supplier management. Formal appraisals produce maturity level ratings.
reputation: Standard in U.S. defense/government contracting; widely used in software development globally.
notes: Formal appraisals are expensive; criticized for bureaucracy at higher levels.
